exposure: Maternal group B streptococcal (GBS) intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis (IAP)
outcome: Rate of weight change from birth to 5 years
finding: GBS-specific IAP was associated with a modest increase in the rate of early childhood weight gain.
mod_finding: This study found that infants exposed to maternal group B streptococcal intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis (IAP) had a modestly elevated rate of weight gain in the first 5 years of life, with the effect being more pronounced in infants born via cesarean section.
